name: Onychydra
ability: Hydrostatic (its own: its Water-type moves get the same-type bonus too) / Sticky Hold / Swarm (hidden)
look: a great hunched worm-dragon of red-orange rings joined by glossy cyan jelly bands, a rearing neck fronted by a huge cyan water sac, sacs on its thick legs, dark-red lobed toes, a segmented tail with a grey spike, a red hood with a black band, round orange eye discs and a hooked grey beak
entry: Its body has no bones: the great water sacs along its neck and legs hold it up, and it fills them at rivers before a fight. One blast from its beak can knock a boulder off a cliff, or glue a flock of Flying Pokémon to the sky.
how: Evolve Nozzlurm at level 40, learning Dragon Pulse.
Wild: rare in jungles and swamps while it rains.
